title: Project Open Data Metadata Schema v1.1 — required-field subset
description: Task cc_tasks/2026-09-06_scan_targets.md §2, disposition of the D4 `deviates` finding: RULE-D4-v1's spec says 'validate against the POD v1.1 schema' and the rule gated only on the catalog being present and containing the product, so a catalog that fails POD validation still passed. SCOPE, stated rather than implied: this is the REQUIRED-field subset of the Project Open Data Metadata Schema v1.1 (the federal /data.json profile of DCAT mandated by the OPEN Government Data Act and M-13-13) — conformsTo and dataset on the catalog, and title, description, keyword, modified, publisher, contactPoint, identifier, accessLevel on each dataset. It is NOT the full POD schema, which also carries controlled vocabularies, format constraints and conditional requirements. D4-v2 reports `schema_profile: pod_v1_1_min` on every Finding so a pass here cannot be read as POD conformance.
